responsibility: This file is the C front end’s top-level lang_hooks instantiation. It identifies the language as GNU C, selects the shared C/Objective-C initialization hooks, provides the C-specific selftest hook when checking is enabled, installs the substring-location hook, and emits the final `lang_hooks` object that connects the GCC core to the C front end’s behavior.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the implementation side of the c-lang pair: it instantiates the C front end’s lang_hooks object and defines the few C-specific hook bindings layered on top of the shared C/Objective-C hooks, whereas gcc/c/c-lang.h declares the GTY-managed C language data structures such as lang_type and language_function.
